cases.title: orders, fragment common-surname 'kaczmarek', page 1 by the bigrams
cases.sql: SELECT o.id, o.number, o.placed_at, o.status, o.email, o.full_name, o.total_gross, o.currency, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) FROM ordering_order_line l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) AS item_count, o.refund_amount, o.refund_due_at, o.refund_completed_at FROM ordering_order o WHERE perf_bigrams(lower(o.number || E'\x1f' || o.email || E'\x1f' || o.full_name)) @> perf_bigrams(lower('kaczmarek')) AND lower(o.number || E'\x1f' || o.email || E'\x1f' || o.full_name) LIKE '%' || lower('kaczmarek') || '%' ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 26
